author: Mike Okay
description:
At the port in Wewak, hundreds of passengers were waiting to board one of Papua New Guinea’s coastal ships, one of the only affordable ways to travel between remote towns. With no guarantee of getting on, I waited until the very last moment… and somehow managed to secure a spot.
